title: Rosalind and the Kitchen
author: Kestrel Blackwood
blurb: Lior Thornbury, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
